channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Five deaths on Michigan trail raise serial killer fears
item.description: Authorities are investigating whether a serial killer is responsible for five deaths discovered along a trail in Michigan. Fears of a serial killer have grown following the discovery of the bodies. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.
